changelog:
Safe mode, and a playlist setting that finally does what it says.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings, Content has Safe mode. When it is on, channels, films and series marked adult are hidden from browsing, search and the More like this row, and categories with adult names are hidden from the category list. It is off unless you turn it on, and switching it never needs a refresh.
- Plex titles are now checked for adult content by their title and library name, as panels and playlists already were.
- Select all in the category list never switches on a category that safe mode is hiding.
- For a playlist source, turning off Hide section headers when editing it now keeps those header lines as rows after the next refresh. Before, they were always removed.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Your language filter and category choices work as before.

NOT YET

- Safe mode can be a little slower on very large catalogs until it gets its own index.
- A refresh still works out each channel's language again rather than keeping it.
